title: Blow too hard and you'll pass out 😵
caption:
Party tip nobody tells you 🎈
Tag the one who always blows them up 👇
sources: Cleveland Clinic, 'Hyperventilation' (low carbon dioxide narrows brain blood vessels; dizziness, tingling, fainting)
Cleveland Clinic, 'Valsalva Maneuver' (straining raises chest pressure and reduces blood returning to the heart; can cause light-headedness)
